topic: Digital modes: how they work and how to operate them (G8C, G2E; 30 pool questions)

questions.question: Which mode is normally used when sending RTTY signals via AFSK with an SSB transmitter?

choices.A: USB
choices.C: CW

questions.question: What is VARA?

choices.A: A low signal-to-noise digital mode used for EME (moonbounce)
choices.B: A digital protocol used with Winlink
choices.C: A radio direction finding system used on VHF and UHF
choices.D: A DX spotting system using a network of software defined radios

questions.answer: A digital protocol used with Winlink

questions.question: What symptoms may result from other signals interfering with a PACTOR or VARA transmission?

choices.A: Frequent retries or timeouts
choices.C: Failure to establish a connection between stations

questions.question: Which of the following is good practice when choosing a transmitting frequency to answer a station calling CQ using FT8?

choices.A: Always call on the station’s frequency
choices.B: Call on any frequency in the waterfall except the station’s frequency
choices.C: Find a clear frequency during the same time slot as the calling station
choices.D: Find a clear frequency during the alternate time slot to the calling station

questions.answer: Find a clear frequency during the alternate time slot to the calling station

questions.question: What is the standard sideband for JT65, JT9, FT4, or FT8 digital signal when using AFSK?

choices.A: LSB
choices.C: DSB

questions.question: What is the most common frequency shift for RTTY emissions in the amateur HF bands?

choices.A: 85 Hz
choices.C: 425 Hz

questions.question: Which of the following is required when using FT8?

choices.A: A special hardware modem
choices.B: Computer time accurate to within approximately 1 second
choices.C: Receiver attenuator set to -12 dB

questions.answer: Computer time accurate to within approximately 1 second

questions.question: In what segment of the 20-meter band are most digital mode operations commonly found?

choices.A: At the bottom of the slow-scan TV segment, near 14.230 MHz
choices.B: At the top of the SSB phone segment, near 14.325 MHz
choices.C: In the middle of the CW segment, near 14.100 MHz

questions.question: How do you join a contact between two stations using the PACTOR protocol?

choices.A: Send broadcast packets containing your call sign while in MONITOR mode
choices.B: Transmit a steady carrier until the PACTOR protocol times out and disconnects
choices.C: Joining an existing contact is not possible, PACTOR connections are limited to two stations

questions.answer: Joining an existing contact is not possible, PACTOR connections are limited to two stations

questions.question: Which of the following is a way to establish contact with a digital messaging system gateway station?

choices.A: Send an email to the system control operator
choices.C: Respond when the station broadcasts its SSID
choices.D: Transmit a connect message on the station’s published frequency

questions.answer: Transmit a connect message on the station’s published frequency

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of an Amateur Radio Emergency Data Network (AREDN) mesh network?

choices.A: To provide FM repeater coverage in remote areas
choices.B: To provide real time propagation data by monitoring amateur radio transmissions worldwide
choices.C: To provide high-speed data services during an emergency or community event
choices.D: To provide DX spotting reports to aid contesters and DXers

questions.answer: To provide high-speed data services during an emergency or community event

questions.question: Which of the following describes Winlink?

choices.A: An amateur radio wireless network to send and receive email on the internet
choices.C: A wireless network capable of both VHF and HF band operation

questions.question: What is another name for a Winlink Remote Message Server?

choices.A: Terminal Node Controller
choices.C: RJ-45

questions.question: What could be wrong if you cannot decode an RTTY or other FSK signal even though it is apparently tuned in properly?

choices.A: The mark and space frequencies may be reversed
choices.B: You may have selected the wrong baud rate
choices.C: You may be listening on the wrong sideband

questions.question: Which of the following is a common location for FT8?

choices.A: Anywhere in the voice portion of the band
choices.B: Anywhere in the CW portion of the band
choices.C: Approximately 14.074 MHz to 14.077 MHz

questions.question: Which digital mode is used as a low-power beacon for assessing HF propagation?

choices.A: WSPR
choices.C: PSK31

questions.question: What part of a packet radio frame contains the routing and handling information?

choices.A: Directory
choices.C: Header

questions.question: Which of the following describes Baudot code?

choices.A: A 7-bit code with start, stop, and parity bits
choices.B: A code using error detection and correction
choices.C: A 5-bit code with additional start and stop bits
choices.D: A code using SELCAL and LISTEN

questions.answer: A 5-bit code with additional start and stop bits

questions.question: In an ARQ mode, what is meant by a NAK response to a transmitted packet?

choices.A: Request retransmission of the packet
choices.C: Receiving station connected and ready for transmissions

questions.question: What action results from a failure to exchange information due to excessive transmission attempts when using an ARQ mode?

choices.A: The checksum overflows
choices.C: Packets will be routed incorrectly
choices.D: Encoding reverts to the default character set

questions.question: Which of the following narrow-band digital modes can receive signals with very low signal-to-noise ratios?

choices.A: MSK144
choices.C: AMTOR

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about PSK31?

choices.A: Upper case letters are sent with more power
choices.B: Upper case letters use longer Varicode bit sequences and thus slow down transmission
choices.C: Error correction is used to ensure accurate message reception
choices.D: Higher power is needed as compared to RTTY for similar error rates

questions.answer: Upper case letters use longer Varicode bit sequences and thus slow down transmission

questions.question: Which is true of mesh network microwave nodes?

choices.A: Having more nodes increases signal strengths
choices.B: If one node fails, a packet may still reach its target station via an alternate node
choices.C: Links between two nodes in a network may have different frequencies and bandwidths
choices.D: More nodes reduce overall microwave out of band interference

questions.answer: If one node fails, a packet may still reach its target station via an alternate node

questions.question: How does forward error correction (FEC) allow the receiver to correct data errors?

choices.A: By controlling transmitter output power for optimum signal strength
choices.B: By using the Varicode character set
choices.C: By transmitting redundant information with the data
choices.D: By using a parity bit with each character

questions.answer: By transmitting redundant information with the data

questions.question: How are the two separate frequencies of a Frequency Shift Keyed (FSK) signal identified?

choices.A: Dot and dash
choices.C: High and low

questions.question: Which type of code is used for sending characters in a PSK31 signal?

choices.A: Varicode
choices.C: Volumetric

questions.question: What is indicated on a waterfall display by one or more vertical lines on either side of a data mode or RTTY signal?

choices.A: Long path propagation
choices.C: Insufficient modulation

questions.question: Which of the following describes a waterfall display?

choices.A: Frequency is horizontal, signal strength is vertical, time is intensity
choices.B: Frequency is vertical, signal strength is intensity, time is horizontal
choices.C: Frequency is horizontal, signal strength is intensity, time is vertical
choices.D: Frequency is vertical, signal strength is horizontal, time is intensity

questions.answer: Frequency is horizontal, signal strength is intensity, time is vertical

questions.question: What does an FT8 signal report of +3 mean?

choices.A: The signal is 3 times the noise level of an equivalent SSB signal
choices.C: The signal-to-noise ratio is equivalent to +3dB in a 2.5 kHz bandwidth
choices.D: The signal is 3 dB over S9

questions.answer: The signal-to-noise ratio is equivalent to +3dB in a 2.5 kHz bandwidth

questions.question: Which of the following provide digital voice modes?

choices.A: WSPR, MFSK16, and EasyPAL
choices.C: Winlink, PACTOR II, and PACTOR III
